key_exclusions: refund is issued as voucher, not original tender
policy_text_full: Alaska's Best Value Guarantee issues a voucher if Alaska.com or a competitor's site shows a lower fare within 24 hours of booking. Customer must submit a claim form. Refund form is a voucher — not a cash refund to original tender.
policy_text_relevant_clause: Within 24 hours of booking, customers can claim a voucher if Alaska or a competitor advertises a lower fare; refund is issued as a voucher, not original tender.
